name: Agents Anywhere
description: Connect workspace chat to official or self-hosted Agents Anywhere with explicit consent, encrypted credentials and host-enforced redirect refusal.

en.name: Agents Anywhere
en.description: Connect Pi workspace sessions to official or self-hosted Agents Anywhere. Discover, create, send, synchronize text replies and interrupt tasks.
en.safetyNotes: High risk: net.anyHost is an install-time grant for arbitrary server hosts, not a per-domain prompt. Only connect to a trusted origin you confirm locally. Credentials and, with separate sharing consent, workspace paths, titles, conversation text, model IDs and status go to that server; remote prompts use existing local session permissions. Requires PI-Desktop 0.18.0+ and redirect:error capability; authentication and ingest never follow redirects. Remote HTTP and insecure TLS bypasses are not supported. Optional token storage is password-encrypted; passwords are not saved. Disconnect does not abort accepted turns. Human release review and deployed-server acceptance are still required.

zh-CN.name: Agents Anywhere 远程连接
zh-CN.description: 将 Pi 工作区会话接入官方或自部署 Agents Anywhere，支持发现、新建、发送、同步文字回复和中断任务。
zh-CN.safetyNotes: 高风险：net.anyHost 在安装时授权任意服务器主机访问，不会逐域名弹窗。仅连接您在本地确认的可信源地址。凭据以及另行授权共享的工作区路径、标题、对话文字、模型标识和状态将发往该服务器；远程消息按会话现有权限执行。要求 PI-Desktop 0.18.0+ 及禁止重定向能力，认证和上传均不跟随跳转。不支持远程明文 HTTP 或跳过 TLS 验证。可选密码加密保存令牌，密码不保存。断开不终止已接收任务。仍需人工发布审查及部署环境验收。

author: PI-Desktop Plugin Contributors
changelog: 2.1.0: support user-confirmed self-hosted HTTPS origins through the official net.anyHost permission. Require PI-Desktop 0.18.0+ redirect capability before networking; refuse redirects for authentication, token refresh and session ingest, with terminal sanitized diagnostics. Preserve origin-bound encrypted credentials, scoped session mappings and tab preferences.
